maria: quick heads-up — opened a docs PR to add a troubleshooting entry for "context window exceeded" errors. need an SDK snippet (python + node) and a short migration note about trimming prompt history. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/812

kevin: nice. can you include a realistic example showing prefix caching + token accounting? many teams get confused about when to evict KV cache.

maria: absolutely — planning to add a small diagram and this snippet. keep it tiny so it fits in the error reference page:

```python
# trim history to last N tokens before send
def trim_history(events, max_tokens=2048):
    # naive token count using token length placeholder
    out = []
    total = 0
    for e in reversed(events):
        t = len(e['text'].split())
        if total + t > max_tokens:
            break
        out.insert(0, e)
        total += t
    return out
```

sophie: for node we usually recommend `tokenizer.encode` example (showing BPE count) — can add that. also flagging that the current docs link to the old SDK page; needs updating to /sdk/overview (I can send a PR for the redirect).

ryan: small nit — the fallback behavior paragraph should call out automatic model variant fallback (e.g., long-seq -> quantized-variant) and that it can change latency/cost. also add a short troubleshooting step: check `x-request-reason` header on failed calls.

maria: good catches. I want to keep the troubleshooting steps ordered: 1) confirm token count, 2) reduce context, 3) enable prefix caching, 4) set fallback policy. Will add a link to the runtime docs under /eng-runtime/kv-cache as reference.

kevin: can we also add a one-liner about backoff for 429s when the context trimming is a race with retries? basically: trim first, then retry with exponential backoff — avoid double-sending huge payloads.

maria: yep adding short code pattern + link to retry guidance. also tagging @docs-bot to run linkcheck once I push.

maria: tiktoken + generic BPE is fine. keep the node snippet under 8 lines. after that, ready for review.

maria: noted. thanks everyone — merging after linkcheck passes. will also add a short changelog entry under docs/changelog.md mentioning the migration note for customers moving from unbounded history. :shipit:
